knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

Final document that outlines all the plots for this project. Across both alternative hypothesis, winter and yellowtail flounder, as well as some miscellaneous plots

# Packages needed to load all the plots
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DataExplorer)
library(ROracle)
library(pdbCollaborations)
library(here)
library(ggridges)
library(readr)
```
# Info + data needed to make and load all the plots
Everything is in the google drive to download. 
Need final_resample_resultsAB and CDE for both winter flounder (not labeled) and yellowtail (labeled YT in front). 4 csvs in results
Need final_strata_meansAB and CDE for both winterflounder (not labeled) and yellowtail (labeled YT in front). 4 csvs in results
Need original indices/strata means for both winter flounder (winterFlounder_indices_design.csv, winterFlounder_strata_mean_design.csv) and yellowtail flounder (yellowtailFlounder_indices_design.csv, yellowtailFlounder_strata_mean_design.csv). 4 csvs in data
Need control values for both survey designs, for both species, and for both indices and strata means. 8 csvs in data (ie. winterFlounder_indices_646566_596061.csv, winterFlounder_strata_mean_646566_596061.csv)

```{r}
## Indices (final_resample_process.R)
final_resample_resultsAB <- read.csv("RESULTS/final_resample_resultsAB.csv")
final_resample_resultsCDE <- read.csv("RESULTS/final_resample_resultsCDE.csv")
YTfinal_resample_resultsAB <- read.csv("RESULTS/YTfinal_resample_resultsAB.csv")
YTfinal_resample_resultsCDE <- read.csv("RESULTS/YTfinal_resample_resultsCDE.csv")

## Strata means (final_resample_process.R)
final_strata_meanAB <- read.csv("RESULTS/final_strata_meanAB.csv")
final_strata_meanCDE <- read.csv("RESULTS/final_strata_meanCDE.csv")
YTfinal_strata_meanAB <- read.csv("RESULTS/YTfinal_strata_meanAB.csv")
YTfinal_strata_meanCDE <- read.csv("RESULTS/YTfinal_strata_meanCDE.csv")

## Original survey design (both winter flounder and YT)
original_indices <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/winterFlounder_indices_design.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") %>%
  mutate(number_tows = "all", superstrata = "none", iteration_number = "-1", simID = "-1")
original_strata_mean <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/winterFlounder_strata_mean_design.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") %>%
  mutate(number_tows = "all", superstrata = "none", iteration_number = "-1", simID = "-1")
YToriginal_indices <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/yellowtailFlounder_indices_design.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") %>%
  mutate(number_tows = "all", superstrata = "none", iteration_number = "-1", simID = "-1")
YToriginal_strata_mean <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/yellowtailFlounder_strata_mean_design.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") %>%
  mutate(number_tows = "all", superstrata = "none", iteration_number = "-1", simID = "-1")
## Control values (index and strata means, no resampling)
alt1_indices <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/winterFlounder_indices_646566_596061.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") 
alt1_strata_mean <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/winterFlounder_strata_mean_646566_596061.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") 

alt2_indices <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/winterFlounder_indices_6459_6560_6661.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") 
alt2_strata_mean <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/winterFlounder_strata_mean_6459_6560_6661.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") 

alt1_indicesYT <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/yellowtailFlounder_indices_646566_596061.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") 
alt1_strata_meanYT <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/yellowtailFlounder_strata_mean_646566_596061.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") 

alt2_indicesYT <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/yellowtailFlounder_indices_6459_6560_6661.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") 
alt2_strata_meanYT <- read.csv(here::here("DATA/yellowtailFlounder_strata_mean_6459_6560_6661.csv")) %>%
  DataExplorer::drop_columns("X") 
## Changing number of tows to a factor
final_strata_meanAB$number_tows <- as.factor(final_strata_meanAB$number_tows)
final_resample_resultsAB$number_tows <- as.factor(final_resample_resultsAB$number_tows)

final_strata_meanCDE$number_tows <- as.factor(final_strata_meanCDE$number_tows)
final_resample_resultsCDE$number_tows <- as.factor(final_resample_resultsCDE$number_tows)

YTfinal_strata_meanAB$number_tows <- as.factor(YTfinal_strata_meanAB$number_tows)
YTfinal_resample_resultsAB$number_tows <- as.factor(YTfinal_resample_resultsAB$number_tows)

YTfinal_strata_meanCDE$number_tows <- as.factor(YTfinal_strata_meanCDE$number_tows)
YTfinal_resample_resultsCDE$number_tows <- as.factor(YTfinal_resample_resultsCDE$number_tows)
```
# HMT 1 - Strata Specific means - Control against originals
## Winter flounder
### Alternative 1 - Superstrata AB
#### Weights
```{r}
      alt1_strata_mean %>% #mutate(STRATUM = as.character(STRATUM)) %>%
        filter(STRATUM == "646566") %>% # Plot specified superstrata means using all ("max") tows
        mutate(superstrata = "Stratum A") %>% # Add plain language superstrata name
        ggplot() +
        geom_line(aes(x = YEAR, y = CATCH_WT, colour = superstrata, group = iteration_number), size = 1) +
        # This adds the original series for strata 64-66
        geom_line(data = select(filter(original_strata_mean, STRATUM == 3640), -number_tows, -STRATUM), aes(x = YEAR, y = CATCH_WT, linetype = "64"), colour = "#0072A3", size = 1) + # This adds the original series for strata 64
        geom_line(data = select(filter(original_strata_mean, STRATUM == 3650), -number_tows, -STRATUM), aes(x = YEAR, y = CATCH_WT, linetype = "65"), colour = "#0072A3", size = 1) + # This adds the original series for strata 65
        geom_line(data = select(filter(original_strata_mean, STRATUM == 3660), -number_tows, -STRATUM), aes(x = YEAR, y = CATCH_WT, linetype = "66"), colour = "#0072A3", size = 1) + # This adds the original series for strata 66
        ylab("Mean weight per tow") +
        facet_wrap(.~ SEASON) +
        scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "longdash", "dotted")) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("#FF1493")) +
        labs(linetype = "Original design strata", colour = "Altered design strata")

      alt1_strata_mean %>% #mutate(STRATUM = as.character(STRATUM)) %>% 
        filter(STRATUM == "596061") %>% # Plot specified superstrata means using all ("max") tows
        mutate(superstrata = "Stratum B") %>% # Add plain language superstrata name
        ggplot() +
        geom_line(aes(x = YEAR, y = CATCH_WT, colour = superstrata, group = iteration_number), size = 1) +
        # This adds the original series for strata 59-61
        geom_line(data = select(filter(original_strata_mean, STRATUM == 3590), -number_tows, -STRATUM), aes(x = YEAR, y = CATCH_WT, linetype = "59"), colour = "#0072A3", size = 1) + # This adds the original series for strata 59
        geom_line(data = select(filter(original_strata_mean, STRATUM == 3600), -number_tows, -STRATUM), aes(x = YEAR, y = CATCH_WT, linetype = "60"), colour = "#0072A3", size = 1) + # This adds the original series for strata 60
        geom_line(data = select(filter(original_strata_mean, STRATUM == 3610), -number_tows, -STRATUM), aes(x = YEAR, y = CATCH_WT, linetype = "61"), colour = "#0072A3", size = 1) + # This adds the original series for strata 61
        ylab("Mean weight per tow") +
        facet_wrap(.~SEASON) +
        scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "longdash", "dotted")) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("#FF1493")) +
        labs(linetype = "Original design strata", colour = "Altered design strata")
```

        filter(PURPOSE_CODE == 10) %>%

# Analysis plots
## HMT 1 analysis
```{r}
joining_original_strata_meanWF <- original_strata_mean %>%
  filter(PURPOSE_CODE == 10) %>%
  select(YEAR, SEASON, CATCH_WT, CATCH_NO, STRATUM) %>%
  filter(STRATUM == 3590 | STRATUM == 3600 | STRATUM == 3610 | STRATUM == 3640 | STRATUM == 3650 | STRATUM == 3660)
joining_original_strata_meanYT <- YToriginal_strata_mean %>%
  filter(PURPOSE_CODE == 10) %>%
  select(YEAR, SEASON, CATCH_WT, CATCH_NO) %>%
  filter(STRATUM == 3590 | STRATUM == 3600 | STRATUM == 3610 | STRATUM == 3640 | STRATUM == 3650 | STRATUM == 3660)


plotting_alt1_strata_means <- alt1_strata_mean %>%
  filter(PURPOSE_CODE == 10) %>%
  mutate(wf_CATCH_WT = CATCH_WT, wf_CATCH_NO = CATCH_NO) %>%
  select(YEAR, SEASON, wf_CATCH_WT, wf_CATCH_NO) %>%
  left_join(., joining_original_strata_meanWF) %>%
  mutate(difference_wf1 = wf_CATCH_WT - CATCH_WT,
         Difference = case_when(difference_wf1 > 0 ~ "alt1 > original",
                                difference_wf1 < 0 ~ "alt1 < original",
                                difference_wf1 == 0 ~ "Equal")) 
plotting_alt2_indices <- alt2_indices %>%
  filter(PURPOSE_CODE == 10) %>%
  mutate(wf_STRAT_MEAN_WT = STRAT_MEAN_WT, wf_STRAT_MEAN_NO = STRAT_MEAN_NO) %>%
  select(YEAR, SEASON, wf_STRAT_MEAN_WT, wf_STRAT_MEAN_NO) %>%
  left_join(., joining_original_indicesWF) %>%
  mutate(difference_wf2 = wf_STRAT_MEAN_WT - STRAT_MEAN_WT,
         Difference = case_when(difference_wf2 > 0 ~ "alt1 > original",
                                difference_wf2 < 0 ~ "alt1 < original",
                                difference_wf2 == 0 ~ "Equal"))
plotting_alt1_indicesYT <- alt1_indicesYT %>%
  filter(PURPOSE_CODE == 10) %>%
  mutate(yt_STRAT_MEAN_WT = STRAT_MEAN_WT, yt_STRAT_MEAN_NO = STRAT_MEAN_NO) %>%
  select(YEAR, SEASON, yt_STRAT_MEAN_WT, yt_STRAT_MEAN_NO) %>%
  left_join(., joining_original_indicesYT) %>%
  mutate(difference_yt1 = yt_STRAT_MEAN_WT - STRAT_MEAN_WT,
         Difference = case_when(difference_yt1 > 0 ~ "alt1 > original",
                                difference_yt1 < 0 ~ "alt1 < original",
                                difference_yt1 == 0 ~ "Equal")) 
plotting_alt2_indicesYT <- alt2_indicesYT %>%
  filter(PURPOSE_CODE == 10) %>%
  mutate(yt_STRAT_MEAN_WT = STRAT_MEAN_WT, yt_STRAT_MEAN_NO = STRAT_MEAN_NO) %>%
  select(YEAR, SEASON, yt_STRAT_MEAN_WT, yt_STRAT_MEAN_NO) %>%
  left_join(., joining_original_indicesYT) %>%
  mutate(difference_yt2 = yt_STRAT_MEAN_WT - STRAT_MEAN_WT,
         Difference = case_when(difference_yt2 > 0 ~ "alt1 > original",
                                difference_yt2 < 0 ~ "alt1 < original",
                                difference_yt2 == 0 ~ "Equal")) 
ggplot() +
      geom_line(data = plotting_alt1_indices, aes(x=YEAR, y = difference_wf1), color = "blue") +
      geom_line(data = plotting_alt2_indices, aes(x=YEAR, y = difference_wf2), color = "red") +
      geom_line(data = plotting_alt1_indicesYT, aes(x=YEAR, y = difference_yt1), color = "yellow3") +
      geom_line(data = plotting_alt2_indicesYT, aes(x=YEAR, y = difference_yt2), color = "purple") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
      facet_wrap(.~SEASON) +
      labs(x = "Year",
           y = "Difference in index weights between alternative and original", 
           color = "Legend") +
      scale_color_manual(values = colors)
```

### Differences between index controls across wf and ytf - alt1 - weights
```{r}
alt1_indices %>%
  filter(PURPOSE_CODE == 10) %>%
  mutate(wf_STRAT_MEAN_NO = STRAT_MEAN_NO, wf_STRAT_MEAN_WT = STRAT_MEAN_WT) %>%
  select(YEAR, SEASON, PURPOSE_CODE, wf_STRAT_MEAN_NO, wf_STRAT_MEAN_WT) %>%
  left_join(., alt1_indicesYT) %>%
  mutate(diff_STRAT_MEAN_WT = wf_STRAT_MEAN_WT - STRAT_MEAN_WT,
         Difference = case_when(diff_STRAT_MEAN_WT > 0 ~ "wf > ytf",
                                diff_STRAT_MEAN_WT < 0 ~ "wf < ytf",
                                diff_STRAT_MEAN_WT == 0 ~ "Equal"))%>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x=YEAR, y = diff_STRAT_MEAN_WT)) +
  geom_point(aes(x=YEAR, y = diff_STRAT_MEAN_WT, colour = Difference), size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  #geom_vline(xintercept = 2018, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(.~SEASON) +
  ylab("Difference in index weights") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#1482f4", "#f4df14"))
```
